verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes concrete illustration requirements for cartoon styling, grill contents, slogan text, smoke-like rendering, and text readability.
First concrete failure: the reviewed grill contains the wrong items and does not yet meet the requested styling and readability criteria.
The client adds a concrete visual acceptance condition requiring the steaks to match the shape shown in the supplied sample.
Distinct reviewed failure: the text remains insufficiently readable and the steak shape does not match the sample.
The generic completion statement follows requested changes to several designs and does not independently resolve the grill illustration as its specific target.
